reigns.note: Eponymous name-twin of Peparethos (modern Skopelos): Apollodorus lists Peparethus among Dionysus and Ariadne's sons begotten on Lemnos; Ovid names the olive-rich isle among those that gave Minos no aid. Neither lens places him as resident or king on the island — city sky stays empty (no honest `skopelos` residence); his attested seat remains Lemnos.
